verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's pricing docs say new users who sign up automatically get a 7-day Free Trial without entering a credit card, then can continue on the Lite plan (no credit card required) with 10 GB of free storage and free monthly compute. That allows real queries on the user's own data, which can be loaded from local DuckDB files, Postgres/MySQL or object storage, or on sample shares like hacker_news. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the no-card, no-sales signup flow, and explicit documentation of Lite-plan compute limits.
